note: Hex values are 6-digit, no leading '#'. pptxgenjs requires this form (no '#', no 8-digit alpha). For docx/xlsx/CSS add '#'.

navy.role: primary dark / default text on light / dark backgrounds

lime.role: accent only — highlights, key figures on dark, CTAs, eyebrow numerals

blue.role: shard/gradient graphics, bullet fills, occasional heading accent

light_blue.role: subtle section tints, table banding, photo/avatar placeholders

charcoal.role: alternate dark surface, muted body on light, footer text

rules: Sentence case for headings and copy (never Title Case, never ALL CAPS in Inter).
IBM Plex Mono may be sentence case OR UPPERCASE — use it for eyebrows, section numbers, labels, footers, stats.
Do not use any Inter weight/style outside the four allowed. No italics as a system style.
Keep typography simple; let hierarchy come from size and weight, not decoration.

cover_title.note: Regular or Bold. Master deck does NOT embed Inter Light, so avoid Light as a default; use it only for a deliberate elegant look and expect Slides to fall back to Regular.

bullets.note: Blue filled circle is the brand bullet. In pptxgenjs use bullet:{code:'2022'} with a blue run, or a small blue oval shape.

logo.secondary: badge/monogram lockup (D-mark over DEXORY) — only when space-constrained. Files: assets/logos/Dexory_SecondaryLogo_{Navy,White}_RGB.png (1080x1600, ~0.675:1). No lime secondary provided.

placement.lime: accent use on dark surfaces only, sparingly

logo.clear_space: height of the 'D' in the wordmark, squared, on all sides
never: place on busy imagery or a similar-toned background
let other elements overlap or enter the clear space
place primary and secondary logos side by side

graphics.shard_pattern: navy base + translucent blue/navy leaning parallelogram shards + soft blue glow; covers, dividers, closing slides
graphics.iconography: circular icons, navy stroke on a lime fill circle
